Description.description: Show all controls that Dataverse Dialog Builder can create.

label.description: This tab displays LABEL controls that you can add to the HEADER, TABHEADER, or SECTION with the setting 'Title' set to true or false.
This tab displays TEXTBOX controls that you can add to a SECTION. TEXTBOX has five types: Text, Email, URL, Ticker Symbol, and Phone that you can configure.
This tab displays TEXTAREA controls that you can add to a SECTION. By default, they use 3 rows for height control, but you can adjust this as needed.
This tab displays DATETIME controls that you can add to a SECTION. DATETIME has three types: Date Time, Date, and Time that you can configure.
Note: When you configure Time type, make sure to set the Date value for this control during the OnLoad event.
This tab displays NUMBER controls that you can add to a SECTION. NUMBER has four types: Whole Number, Decimal Number, Floating Point Number, and Currency that you can configure.
Note: The symbol of the currency type will be displayed as the base currency. You cannot change it.
This tab displays LOOKUP controls that you can add to a SECTION.
This tab displays REGARDING controls that you can add to a SECTION.
Note: The REGARDING controls are the same as LOOKUP controls, but they select all entities that have the Activity setting set to true.
This tab displays IFRAME controls that you can add to a SECTION. By default, they use 5 rows for height control, but you can adjust this as needed.
This tab displays DROPDOWN controls that you can add to a SECTION. DROPDOWN has three types: Language, Time Zone, and Duration that you can configure.

This tab displays OPTIONSET controls that you can add to a SECTION. OPTIONSET have two types: OptionSet, and MultiSelect OptionSet. Each type you can configure as dynamic values, local OptionSet value, or global OptionSet value.
This tab displays TWOOPTIONS controls that you can add to a SECTION. TWOOPTIONS have three types: Dropdown, Checkbox, and Toggle that you can configure.
This tab displays SUBGRID controls that you can add to a SECTION. You can configure properties to determine what you want to display.
This tab displays CHART controls that you can add to a SECTION. You can configure properties to determine what you want to display.
This tab displays RICH TEXT BOX controls that you can add to a SECTION. You can configure the RTEGlobalConfiguration.json file to show/hide toolbars.
This tab displays ENTITY OPTIONSET controls that you can add to a SECTION.
Note: This control will populate all entities of the current environment to the OPTIONSET control.
This tab displays ADVANCED FIND controls that you can add to a SECTION.
This tab displays ADVANCED FIND RESULT controls that you can add to a SECTION.
This tab displays UPLOAD controls that you can add to a SECTION.
This tab displays ADVANCED FIND AND RESULT controls that you can add to a SECTION.
This tab displays MULTISELECT LOOKUP controls that you can add to a SECTION.
